name: sooool
objective: Online GPT visual decisions that solve robot table tennis under measured inference delay, followed by real API transfer

development.auth: ChatGPT subscription only; never API or purchased-credit fallback
development.timing: Measured API delays sampled independently; native computation time affects research wall time only
development.selection: Complete paired seeds; compare win rate, then point share and failure trajectories

current_runtime.reason: Completed seed2 pair showed median subscription turn2.54s and artificial shared admission wait9.29s with zero retries; resume seed5 same virtual API condition with gap2.

development.execution_delay_condition: Optional _executor_ mode measures local native lowering/apply wall duration and blocks controller work while physics and inference deadlines advance. It excludes HTTP transport/queue overhead.

retired_held_out_seeds.reason: Real API loss inspected during development, including recorded menus and native counterfactual diagnostics; no longer unseen.

acceptance_proposal.held_out_evaluation_condition: Select after paired development and execution-blocking sensitivity; freeze the complete policy and scheduler before all ten acceptance episodes.

invariants: GPT receives real player camera observations and own-state/referee fields
No hidden ball state or future results are provided to GPT
No model answer becomes visible before its sampled completion time
Only results already visible may affect arbitration
Never apply a previous point's action to a new point
Serialize environment actions even when model reasoning is concurrent
Incomplete episodes are not losses or zero scores
Simulation results are not realtime API results
No paid requests beyond shared ledger reservations
